title: San Francisco Rents Hit Record Highs After 26% Surge
summary:
The rapid expansion of the artificial intelligence industry has drawn a new wave of professionals to the Bay Area, increasing competition for available residential property. This demand has pushed leasing prices in San Francisco up 26%, taking the cost of rent to its highest point in the city's history.

The spike is the result of a housing crunch where the influx of workers has outpaced the construction of new homes. Local rental rates reached these record levels as the AI boom intensified pressure on an already tight housing market.
